messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

messages.text: Our records show the cordless screwdriver was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). We can’t send a refund to a new card; any refund can go only to the order’s original payment. If the old card was cancelled, its issuer handles the credit, and we can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment). If you’d like to proceed to the original payment, let me know.
